properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 1 at 11:08AM EDT until August 1 at 1:15PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 115 PM EDT.

* At 1108 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 14 nm southeast of St. Marks to 9 nm west of Buckeye
Reef to 14 nm south of S Tower, moving east at 30 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
V Tower, Buckeye Reef, Horseshoe Beach, and Marker 24 Barge.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued August 1 at 11:07AM CDT until August 3 at 9:00PM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
...The Flood Watch is extended for the following rivers in Iowa...

Wapsipinicon River near De Witt 4S affecting Scott and Clinton
Counties.

* WHAT...Flooding is possible.

* WHERE...Wapsipinicon River near De Witt 4S.

* WHEN...From Sunday morning to Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 11.0 feet, Water affects County Road E63 north of the
river near Toronto and affects the lowest roads in Buena Vista.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:30 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 8.3 feet and rising.
- Forecast...Flood stage may be reached tomorrow morning.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
If you are in the watch area, remain alert to possible flooding.

Residents and those with interests near the river should monitor
rising water levels and be prepared for possible Flood Warnings.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/quadcities.

The next statement will be issued by Sunday morning.

properties.areaDesc: Cook, IL; DuPage, IL; Kane, IL; Kendall, IL; Will, IL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 1 at 11:00AM CDT until August 1 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Central Cook County in northeastern Illinois...
DuPage County in northeastern Illinois...
Southeastern Kane County in northeastern Illinois...
Kendall County in northeastern Illinois...
Northwestern Will County in northeastern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 100 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. High
water may recede slowly from flooded areas. Area creeks and streams
are already elevated, increasing the risk of flooding due to
additional rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1058 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain from earlier this morning. Flooding is ongoing in the
warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain have fallen.
- Scattered heavy rain showers late this morning may result in
additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch in the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Chicago, Aurora, Joliet, Naperville, Cicero, Evanston,
Bolingbrook, Skokie, Berwyn, Wheaton, Oak Park, Downers Grove,
Elmhurst, Lombard, Romeoville, Plainfield, Park Ridge and
Addison.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means flooding is imminent or may already be
occurring. Persons along rivers, creeks, and other waterways should
take immediate precautions to protect life and property.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 PM CDT THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 1 at 8:24AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 25.6 feet Thursday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 1 at 8:13AM CDT until August 2 at 4:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Illinois...

East Branch Du Page River at Bolingbrook affecting DuPage and Will
Counties.

Du Page River at Shorewood affecting Will County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...East Branch Du Page River from Maple Avenue in Lisle
downstream to confluence with West Branch DuPage River, including
the Bolingbrook gauge.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, DuPage River Greenway Trail is threatened
east of the river near Royce Road in Bolingbrook. Trails threatened
at Green Valley Forest Preserve near Woodridge.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:40 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 18.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon to a crest of 20.3 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage late this evening.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means water levels above flood stage are imminent or
may already be occurring. Persons along rivers and streams in the
warned area should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

These forecasts are based on observed precipitation as well as
forecast precipitation 24 hours into the future. Changes to the
rainfall forecast, or any additional rainfall after 24 hours, may
cause changes to these river forecasts.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 215 AM CDT.
